senses.gloss: (b. h.; v. Ges. H. Dict.10 s. v.) father-in-law, husband’s father, wife’s father.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Yevamot 15:7">Yeb. XV, 7</cite> <cite ref="H01172"><he>חָמִי</he></cite> my husband’s father.
Pes. 87ᵃ כלה בבית חָמִיהָ a bride in the house of her father-in-law (after being conducted to the husband’s home); a. v. fr.—Fem. חָמוֹת q. v.
